_readme: Limits that stop bots guessing passwords or flooding the sign-up and reset forms. Edit here; no code change needed.
login.maxFailuresPerAccount: wrong passwords for one login ID before it is locked for lockoutMinutes.
login.maxAttemptsPerIp: login attempts of any kind from one network address per windowMinutes.
register / forgotPassword / resetPassword: requests from one network address per windowMinutes.
Counters live in the server's memory, so a restart clears them.
